subject: IAM evidence request and SOC 2 status — Novus Medical (next steps)
messages:
From: Samantha Greene <samantha.greene@novusmedical.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: IAM & compliance items from today's call

Hi Marissa / Aditya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Novus Medical is moving quickly and we wanted to capture the open items related to Identity & Access Management and compliance so we can start our procurement/security review. Action items from our side: we will kick off the vendor security questionnaire, but we need the following evidence from Redwood to proceed:

1) SOC 2 attestation (Type II if available) or an approximate ETA on the latest report; any SOC 2 scope details (data center, control areas) would be helpful.
2) High-level GDPR/HIPAA posture and whether Redwood is willing to sign a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) / BAAs for PHI scenarios.
3) IAM evidence: SSO/SAML IdP metadata or SP metadata, ACS/Entity IDs, supported SAML attributes.
4) SCIM provisioning: endpoint URLs, auth method, supported schemas (users/groups), rate limits.
5) RBAC and admin controls: list of built-in roles, ability to restrict admin console, delegation model, audit log retention for admin actions.

I've attached our vendor security questionnaire (we'll fill out the vendor side once we have the answers), and Tom will be the technical lead. Can you confirm timeline to share the requested artifacts? Ideally we'd have the IAM artifacts and SOC 2 info within 3 business days to keep to our procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Greene
Director, IT Security
Novus Medical

Attachment: vendor_security_questionnaire.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Greene <samantha.greene@novusmedical.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM & compliance items from today's call

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the clear list — and great to meet you on the call. We're happy to move forward and will aim to get the core IAM evidence over in the next 48 hours. Quick updates below and attached are the initial artifacts you asked for:

- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report covering the inference control plane and customer data processing. We can share the redacted report under an NDA; alternatively we can provide the SOC 2 summary and scope. Please let me know if Novus requires the full report (we typically send via secure link or DocuSign for acknowledgement).

- GDPR / HIPAA: We support GDPR controls and have a DPA template. For HIPAA, we will sign a BAA when Novus requires PHI processing — we have an internal checklist and controls mapped to HIPAA requirements.

- SSO / SAML: attached is our current IdP metadata (idp_metadata.xml) and a short Service Provider configuration guide. Our SP ACS URL: https://api.redwoodinference.com/saml/acs ; SP Entity ID: urn:redwood:sp

- SCIM: We support SCIM 2.0 for user provisioning. SCIM endpoint (provisioning) will be provided as a tenant-specific URL; auth is via bearer token with scoped credentials. I'll open a ticket with Engineering to generate a tenant SCIM token and endpoint for Novus and share by Friday 2027-03-19.

- RBAC / Admin controls: attached access_control_matrix.csv shows built-in roles and permissions (Admin, Billing Admin, Workspace Admin, Developer, Read-only). Admin console access can be restricted by SCIM group mappings and SSO assertions. Audit logs for admin actions are retained for 365 days by default (longer retention options as an add-on).

Next steps I propose:
- I'll upload the SOC 2 redacted PDF to a secure link once we have an NDA signed (I can send a DocuSign envelope for the DPA/attachment if you prefer).
- Engineering to provide SCIM tenant endpoint and provisioning token by Fri 2027-03-19.
- Schedule a 30-minute technical handoff (Tom + our infra engineer) to walk through SSO/SCIM config — available Tue/Wed next week.

Let me know if that timeline works and whether you'd like the SOC 2 summary first or to proceed with the NDA.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Solutions — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: idp_metadata.xml, access_control_matrix.csv

From: Tom Li <tom.li@novusmedical.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Greene <samantha.greene@novusmedical.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM & compliance items from today's call

Marissa — thanks for the fast turnaround and the artifacts. A couple of technical clarifications so we can move the configuration forward: 

1) For SAML, can you confirm the NameID formats you accept (email / urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress)? Also which attributes do you require in the assertion (e.g., email, firstName, lastName, groups)?
2) For SCIM, will the tenant-scoped provisioning token have user:write and group:write scopes? Any rate limits we should be aware of for initial sync (we typically do a bulk push of ~5k users).
3) Regarding audit logs: are logs accessible via API or will they be part of an exported bundle? We need to confirm retention & access for our security team.

If Engineering can provide the SCIM endpoint + token, we'll start a test provisioning to our dev environment. Preferred window for the technical handoff: Wed 2027-03-17 14:00 PST.

Thanks,
Tom
Senior IT Architect
Novus Medical

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@novusmedical.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Greene <samantha.greene@novusmedical.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 15:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM & compliance items from today's call

Tom / Samantha —

Great questions. Quick answers and actions (internal next steps included):

1) NameID / Attributes: We accept NameID as email (urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress). Required assertion attributes: email, givenName, familyName. groups is optional but recommended for RBAC mapping. I'll attach the SP attribute mapping after the handoff.

2) SCIM scopes / rate limits: Tenant token will include user:write, user:read, group:write, group:read. For initial sync, we recommend throttling to 200 reqs/min; Engineering can temporarily raise limits for the first bulk import — I'll request this. Expect the tenant SCIM endpoint + token by end of day Fri 2027-03-19.

3) Audit logs: Admin action logs are exportable via our Audit API; we can provide a read-only service account that Novus can use to pull logs for the retention window. Default retention is 365 days; we can extend to 3 years as an add-on.

Internal note: @Aditya / @Priyom — please create Eng ticket to (1) generate tenant SCIM endpoint & token for novus-medical, (2) prepare temporary rate-limit bump for initial import, (3) share SP attribute mapping doc. Assign to infra squad and aim for EOD Fri.

Samantha / Tom — I'll also send a DocuSign envelope for the DPA so we can share the SOC 2 redacted PDF securely. Please confirm availability for the handoff Wed 2027-03-17 14:00 PST — if that works, I'll calendar invite and include our infra engineer.

Best,
Marissa
Head of Solutions — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
